summary: Every acceptance criterion has implementing work on main. V01-V04 and V08-V10 are P1/P2's prevent_destroy, name-free guard (all three callers, no `|| true`) and the drift job's refusal naming. V06 is P5's doctrine, V07 is P3's single-call plan/guard/apply, V09 is P4's runbooks plus P1's comments, V12-V16 are P6's catchError helpers, and V17 closed by ruling. V05, V07's live proof, V10's rollout and V11 are operator- or run-owed verification rather than unbuilt work; the remaining stale docs (terraform/README.md:5, support/iac-agent/README.md:12, iac-agent.md:26-37) are routed to the enabled doc phase, and a grep finds no other guard caller passing names and no prd -replace left. The one mechanical residue, close-out S2's two comments claiming managed-vm ignores all of initialization, is fixed in Ansible 2738c38 and AnsibleSpecs d7bb25a and struck.
